subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the initial dashboard contract ship MCP-app widgets now, and if so which authorized descriptor or ticketed rendering path is the permanent client contract?
rationale: The branch publicly advertises `mcp-app` widgets but does not expose a client-renderable representation, so choosing whether to implement or defer that capability is a product and protocol contract decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Complete the MCP-app contract
options.body: Expose one authorized renderable or reconstructable MCP-app path and add focused protocol/client compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Defer MCP-app widgets
options.body: Remove the public MCP-app option from this PR and land the HTML-only board contract, leaving MCP-app support for a separately reviewed extension.

recommendation.title: Complete the MCP-app contract
recommendation.body: Expose one authorized renderable or reconstructable MCP-app path and add focused protocol/client compatibility coverage before merge.
